AUTOSAR shall provide mechanisms to support safe initialization of software components.

AUTOSAR shall provide mechanisms to support safe verification mechanisms of platform basic software modules, functional-clusters, software components, applications, services and their respective configuration data.
AUTOSAR shall provide mechanisms to support safe shutdown and termination of applications, software components, basic software modules and services.
AUTOSAR shall provide mechanisms to support safe transition of states in a basic software module, software component, application or service life cycle.

AUTOSAR shall provide mechanisms to support safe resource management for the AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform functional-clusters, applications and services and AUTOSAR Classic Platform basic software modules and software components.
AUTOSAR shall provide an interface to support safe communication for basic software module, software component, application or services.
AUTOSAR shall provide mechanisms to prevent the loss of a valid configuration.

AUTOSAR shall provide mechanisms to support dependable scheduling of AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform functional-clusters, applications and services and AUTOSAR Classic Platform basic software modules and software components.
AUTOSAR shall provide mechanisms to support safe program execution.
AUTOSAR shall provide mechanisms to detect program execution time violation
AUTOSAR shall provide mechanisms to prevent unintended alteration of data.
AUTOSAR shall provide mechanisms to support that the safety relevant software is only updated/upgraded in a state that cannot cause a hazardous situation.
AUTOSAR shall support mechanisms to detect unintended alteration of data.
AUTOSAR shall support data recovery mechanisms.
AUTOSAR shall allow integrators to select and configure the set of safety mechanisms to detect communication faults.
AUTOSAR shall provide mechanisms to detect time synchronization violations.
Health Monitoring shall provide an Alive Supervision
Health Monitoring shall provide a Logical Supervision
Health Monitoring shall provide a Deadline Supervision
If supervision of State Management fails then Platform Health Management shall trigger a watchdog reset.
If supervision of Execution Management fails then Platform Health Management shall trigger a watchdog reset.

Platform Health Management shall notify State Management in case an AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform functional cluster, Adaptive Application or service other than Execution Management and State Management fails.
PHM shall only process a checkpoint reported from corresponding processes.
A security event shall be raised if a checkpoint is reported from a non-corresponding process.
Execution Management shall set-up one process for the execution of each Modelled Process.
Execution Management shall support the configuration of OS resource budgets for process and groups of processes.
Execution Management shall support the binding of all threads of a given process to a specified set of processor cores.
Execution Management shall control the right to create child process for each process it starts.
Execution Management shall be implemented at least according the highest safety integrity level from any process that is supported on the platform.
State Management shall be implemented at least according to the highest safety integrity level from any process that is managed by State Management.
State Management shall coordinate recovery actions.
The Operating System shall provide mechanisms for system memory budgeting.
The Operating System shall provide mechanisms for CPU time budgeting.
The Operating System should provide mechanisms for binding Processes to CPU cores.
The Operating System shall provide multi-Process support for isolation of applications.

The Communication Management shall protect the transmission of events using E2E protocol. The E2E Protection has to be executed behind the event API.
The communication management shall provide the E2E information of the received event to the application.
Communication Management shall protect the transmission of methods using E2E protocol.
The communication management shall provide the E2E information of the received method call to the application.
Communication management shall provide an interface to detect delay of E2E protected service responses at the client side by supervision of a predefined response deadline.
The communication management shall provide the E2E information of the method response to the application.
UCM shall support a recovery mechanism in case of failed activation
UCM shall check the consistency of transferred Software Package
UCM shall be able to safely recover from unexpected interruption.
UCM shall be able to verify the updated software during activation
Watchdog Manager inherits highest safety integrity level from Software Component.
Watchdog Manager monitors aliveness.
Watchdog Manager monitors control flow.
Watchdog Manager monitors deadline.
